mineds.config.title: MineDS Configuration
mineds.config.option.ai_profiles_desc: Use /mineds aiprofile add to create a template, then edit it in the config file. Profiles starting with __ are hidden from the list.
mineds.config.tooltip.ai_profiles_desc: AI profile JSON. Each profile has url, model, api_key, temperature, max_tokens, system_message
mineds.config.tooltip.command_session_ai: AI profile name for command sessions (/ds, /dsc)
mineds.config.tooltip.advancement_sessio: AI profile name for advancement sessions
mineds.config.tooltip.session_ttl_hours: Session expiration in hours, auto-cleaned when expired (1-168)
mineds.config.tooltip.max_command_sessio: Maximum number of command sessions to keep (excluding favorites)
mineds.config.tooltip.max_advancement_se: Maximum number of advancement sessions to keep (excluding favorites)
mineds.config.tooltip.advancement_filter: BLACKLIST: Filter out matching advancements. WHITELIST: Only allow matching advancements.
mineds.config.tooltip.advancement_blackl: Advancement IDs to exclude from triggering API calls.
mineds.config.tooltip.advancement_whitel: Advancement IDs to allow triggering API calls.
mineds.config.tooltip.advancement_prompt: Template for the message sent when an advancement is triggered. Variables: {title}, {description}, {id}.
